services.name: Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Enjoy a leisurely cruise around the Ballenas-Winchelsea archipelago, and along the coastline of Nanoose Bay. Take in the beauty and wildlife abundant on the rocky windswept islands, with a panoramic backdrop of the distant snowcapped Coast Mountains. We will tour past the historic 100+ year old Ballenas Island lighthouse, to anchor in a sheltered bay for a peaceful moment to enjoy the surroundings. On the slow cruise home, relax astern as the sun drops into the sea, and you soak up the warm light of magic hour. If you have questions, particular circumstances, or a special request, please give us a call to discuss. We will do everything possible to provide you with an unforgettable

services.name: Custom Charters
services.desc: Experience the excitement of catching a Pacific salmon, jig for bottom fish, harvest crab or prawns. There is nothing quite like the thrill of reeling in a pacific salmon. The fishing grounds are only 10-15 minutes offshore, so we can maximize your time on the rods. We fish around the many small islands of the Ballenas-Winchelsea archipelago, providing protection and calmer seas for your comfort. Depending on the time of year, we can also jig for bottom feeders such as lingcod and rockfish, drop crab traps, or prawn traps on full day charters. Haida Gold is outfitted with premium fishing equipment, and your charter includes all bait & tackle, and cleaning of your catch. We welcome all ages

blurb: Guests explore coastal waters of Vancouver Island and the Salish Sea aboard a 30ft Mainship Pilot RumRunner II. Activities include sportfishing with premium gear, scenic cruises, and special event charters like fireworks and memorial cruises. The boat features a covered cabin, enclosed bathroom, galley for picnics, and safety equipment.
